layoutPrinciples: Hard-edged 0px border-radius geometry with white structural rules and restrained 4px offset shadows.
Strategic 10% electric-green accent budget reserved for hero highlight, primary earnings readout, active controls, and primary CTAs.
Side-by-side calculator workspace on desktop collapsing cleanly to single-column touch-friendly stack at 320px.

componentStyling.sectionBand: High-contrast off-white header strip with heavy condensed ink typography

imageryGuidance: Geometric dotted-grid canvas and angular stripe SVG accents; no corporate stock photography or glassmorphism.
accessibilityNotes: Electric green (#00F23D) paired exclusively with near-black (#080808) text (13.6:1 contrast ratio) or used as large display figures on #080808/#141414 (12.8:1 contrast). Body text #F7F7F4 on #080808 exceeds 18:1. Minimum 44px touch targets and visible focus outlines.
